validation_summary.summary: All eight Phase-0 gate criteria pass with real, quoted command evidence on both the synthetic contract fixture and a real 12-month single-symbol tape built from a freshly downloaded, checksum-verified multi-symbol dataset. The one load-bearing invariant (Replay(C, a_actual, M) == observed ledger) holds EXACTLY — 0 mismatches, 0 deviation on every reconciled field — on 766 total executed candidates across both stores combined.

items.text: Gate 3 (no future leakage) — PASS. pit_lineage_problems=[] on both stores (assert_pit_lineage checks every BOUND candidate's birth_state_id resolves and no feature's max_input_available_time exceeds its decision clock).

items.label: FACT
items.text: Gate 4 (legal action manifests always contain the actual action) — PASS. generate_legal_actions seeds the ACTUAL action at element 1 by construction (never by search); test_actual_action_is_always_element_one_and_manifest_contains_it asserts this structurally, and the zero-negative-gap result (VS006) is the same invariant certified empirically at scale.

items.label: FACT
items.text: Gate 5 (undefined/censored replay never becomes fabricated utility) — PASS. Direct unit tests force the degenerate-future and no-entry cases and assert CELL_UNDEFINED_FUTURE/CELL_NO_ENTRY with net_utility=None; on the real tape 571 cells landed CENSORED and 7,780 landed NO_ENTRY, none carrying a fabricated number.
evidence_refs: command: python -c "cube cell_status counts on real tape" -> {OK: 6969, CENSORED: 571, NO_ENTRY: 7780}

items.label: FACT
items.text: Gate 6 (golden synthetic paths pass) plus the v0.2 core invariant (hindsight utility never below actual) — PASS. Zero negative gaps across 543 COMPUTED candidates combined (12 synthetic + 531 real); tie handling verified (175/531 real candidates had a >1 tie set, matching the earlier measured pattern that ties are common, not an edge case).
evidence_refs: command: python -c "gap stats on real tape" -> n_computed=531 negatives=0 mean_gap=0.864

items.label: FACT
items.text: Gate 7 (fault-injection behaviour matches frozen expectations) — PASS. All 5 required cases from v0.2 section 14.3 behave as specified, including the two whose CORRECT behaviour is an explicit refusal (habitat randomization has no context field to claim a localization with; missing evidence fails reconciliation explicitly rather than passing silently).

items.label: FACT
items.text: Gate 8 (reference implementation agrees within its declared semantic subset) — PASS. tools/regret_reference.py, written independently from SIMULATION_TRUTH_SPEC text (imports nothing from v8.simulator), matches CanonicalSimulator on endpoint/net_r/mae_r/mfe_r/horizon_bars/ambiguous_bars across 150 Hypothesis-generated randomized paths plus the empty-future boundary case, on the shared FILL_AT_BAR_CLOSE/zero-cost/zero-funding/static-geometry subset both implement.
